brief:
A graffiti mural in southern Israel portrays the creators of the award-winning documentary "NAZA" in what appears to be a threatening manner, Al-Monitor reported. The street art does not celebrate the filmmakers but instead presents them in a confrontational light, reflecting broader tensions surrounding the film's release.

The documentary has ignited political controversy in Israel since its debut. The work's subject matter and perspective have prompted strong reactions within the country's public discourse and political landscape.
dek: On a street in southern Israel, a graffiti artist paints a mural depicting the filmmakers behind the award-winning documentary "NAZA". But this is not a tribute.
title: Israeli graffiti artist depicts documentary filmmakers as targets
